messages:
alex: Quick check — PR #18322 needs a landing before tonight's deploy-freeze (00:00 UTC). CI is generally green but mac matrix is flaky and we're hitting a ci quota/throttle. Can I get quick eyes? @jamal @maria

jamal: Looking now. what's failing on mac specifically?

alex: Two flaky e2e timeouts on TestUserLogin in the last run. Full log excerpt:
```
=== FAIL: TestUserLogin (0.00s)
timeout waiting for element after 30s
stack: ...
```
Also saw throttling warnings in the queue: "quota exceeded, retrying in 60s".

ci-bot: Build 18322 — macOS-x64: failed (timeout). Rerun queued (attempt 2/3).

sasha: If reruns are slow and we miss the freeze, we should avoid a big post-freeze roll. Options:
- land a canary to dev with rollback hooks
- get a short rebase window + burst slot and land full change
- split PR (not ideal)

maria: +1 to canary if infra signs off. Who can grant the canary toggle? @ops-bot? :thinking_face:

jamal: I can do a quick review. Found two tiny lint nits and one flaky-test guard we can add. If alex patches, I'll approve ASAP. Also rebase to main to pick the infra gating change we merged earlier.

alex: Plan: fix lint + add flaky guard + rebase -> trigger mac-only job (no full matrix) -> if mac passes i'll merge. If mac still flaky and freeze is imminent, we'll do a canary on dev and open a follow-up hotfix. ETA ~25m.

sasha: Sounds good. If quota is the blocker, we can also request a short burst slot from release infra. @ops-bot any free slots in us-west-2?

ops-bot: Eng-release burst slots available: 1 slot in us-west-2 for 40m. Request with `/burst request-id=3168542090 region=us-west-2`

maria: I'll request the slot now and link the request here.

alex: pushed lint + flaky guard changes and rebased onto main. Triggering mac run only:
```bash
ci run --target mac --pr 18322 --single-job
```

ci-bot: mac run started for PR 18322 (job id: mac-98765).

jamal: Reviewing the patch now. If mac comes back green i'll approve and merge before freeze. If it flakes again, i'll still approve and we can land using the burst slot and do a dev canary rollback plan after. :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks — pinging here when mac finishes.

(ci-bot later): mac job completed: success.

alex: mac passed, jamal approved, landing now. Will monitor canary metrics and notify if rollback needed. Thanks everyone. :party_parrot:
